scope: Exploratory model evaluation. Held-out metrics use only images listed in official test_list.txt; test subset is small and not clinical validation.

dataset.labeling: multi-label; repeated filenames across category folders aggregated
dataset.blind_inference: all predictions were obtained from image bytes before manifest labels were read for scoring
dataset.provenance: README identifies these as NIH training images from the local dataset_images table
dataset.evaluation_note: Only official test-split images are used for generalization metrics. Training and validation images are excluded because the model may have seen them.

provenance_review.validation_partition: Recomputed using patient_key and SHA-256 10% validation rule in train_nih.py

evaluation_protocol: Primary metrics are official held-out test subset only; split_mixed_descriptive_only contains all 46 for debugging and must not be interpreted as generalization.
